snippet.title: Moros Protocol - Official Release Window Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Moros Protocol is a sci-fi FPS roguelite set aboard a haunting, pixel-painted battleship stranded in space and overrun by darkness, monsters, and gore. Check out the latest Moros Protocol trailer to see gameplay and more. In Moros Protocol, fight to survive and uncover the secrets of a failed deep-space experiment; every run is a desperate battle against the unknown... and doom itself. Moros Protocol will be available on PC via Steam in Fall 2025.
